scope: Attempt to isolate horizontal scrollbar stepper cells in already-open GTK2/XChat windows without reading conversation content or changing the live session.

observed.method: In-memory grayscale template correlation against the current 15x15 left/right stepper assets, restricted to window edges; inspect only candidate 15x15 tiles.
observed.result: No candidate was verified as a horizontal scrollbar arrow. Candidate tiles were flat trough/background regions, a vertical scrollbar arrow, or the visible host pointer. Their temporary 15x15 crops were removed immediately; no full-window image was retained.

conclusion: The heuristic crop search is inconclusive and must not be repeated as a visual measurement. It neither confirms nor contradicts the reported horizontal-arrow size. R394 remains the valid fresh GTK2 render comparison (all four normal 15x15 cells 0/225 against SR10.4); R396 remains the live VUE normal-state comparison.
next: Only compare the real XChat scrollbar after a safe GTK2 reload/restart is coordinated, or use an isolated GTK2 test application with the selected RC. Preserve active chat sessions.
